person.name: Bandi Sanjay Kumar
person.role: Union Minister of State for Home Affairs | MP, Karimnagar

issue_notes: The residual POCSO thread faded but did not disappear - a latent risk.
Supporters reframed a viral audio leak as a 'BRS conspiracy' against him.
His own handle was largely personal (birthday thank-yous, condolences).
Political volume was the lowest of the three personas.

top_posts.text: Thank you, Hon'ble AP Deputy CM Shri @PawanKalyan Garu, for your warm birthday wishes and blessings.
Grateful to everyone who conveyed birthday blessings; your wishes strengthen my commitment to public service.
'Mounamelanoyi...' Deeply saddened by the demise of legendary playback singer S. Janaki Amma.
Thank you, Hon'ble Union Minister Shri @BjpVarma Garu, for your kind birthday wishes.
Deeply saddened by the passing of Shri Nand Kishore Goenka Ji, father of Shri Subhash Chandra Ji.

topic_notes: Coverage was lighter and more personal than his June (POCSO-dominated) window.
Supporters and the BJP pushed a 'BRS conspiracy' framing of the audio leak.
Etala Rajender and the BJP used Kaleshwaram to attack the CM.
The birthday drew cross-party goodwill (Pawan Kalyan, Manohar Lal).
notes: A rare positive-leaning fortnight, powered by birthday goodwill and base rallying.
The residual POCSO thread lingers as a latent risk.
The BJP kept Bandi adjacent to the week's big story via the Kaleshwaram attack.
His conversation is niche compared with KTR and the CM.

insights: A rare positive-leaning fortnight, powered by birthday goodwill and a base that rallied around a 'BRS conspiracy' framing of an audio leak.
His own handle was largely personal - thank-yous and condolences - with low political volume.
The residual POCSO thread faded but did not disappear; it remains a latent risk.
The BJP used the Kaleshwaram row (Etala Rajender) to keep Bandi adjacent to the week's big story.
Volume is the lowest of the three - his conversation is niche compared with KTR and the CM.
